from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==========================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION
# ==========================================

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction amounts
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal("50000")                  # Sec 16(ia): Old regime standard deduction limit
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal("75000")                  # Sec 115BAC: New regime standard deduction limit

# Sec 10(13A) - HRA Metro city percentage
HRA_METRO_RATE = Decimal("0.50")                      # Sec 10(13A): 50% for metro cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai)
HRA_NON_METRO_RATE = Decimal("0.40")                  # Sec 10(13A): 40% for non-metro cities

# Sec 24(b) & Sec 71(3A) - House property loss limits
HP_INTEREST_LIMIT = Decimal("200000")                 # Sec 24(b): Max interest deduction for self-occupied property
HP_SET_OFF_LIMIT = Decimal("200000")                  # Sec 71(3A): Max loss from house property set off against salary

# Chapter VI-A Deduction Limits (Old Regime)
SEC_80C_LIMIT = Decimal("150000")                     # Sec 80C / Sec 80CCE: Max overall deduction under Sec 80C
SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT = Decimal("50000")                 # Sec 80CCD(1B): Max additional NPS contribution deduction

# Sec 80D - Health Insurance Limits
SEC_80D_SELF_NORMAL = Decimal("25000")                # Sec 80D(i): Max health insurance for self/family (non-senior)
SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")                # Sec 80D(i): Max health insurance for self/family (senior citizen)
SEC_80D_PARENTS_NORMAL = Decimal("25000")             # Sec 80D(ii): Max health insurance for parents (non-senior)
SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")             # Sec 80D(ii): Max health insurance for parents (senior citizen)

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A - Old Regime Slabs (lower_bound, upper_bound, rate)
# Note: upper_bound is exclusive (None for infinity)
SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("250000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("250000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

SLABS_OLD_60_80 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

SLABS_OLD_ABOVE_80 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 115BAC(1A)(iii) - New Regime Slabs
SLABS_NEW = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("400000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("400000"), Decimal("800000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("800000"), Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("2400000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("2400000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 87A - Rebate Thresholds and Limits
REBATE_THRESHOLD_OLD = Decimal("500000")              # Sec 87A (old): Max total income for rebate
REBATE_MAX_OLD = Decimal("12500")                     # Sec 87A (old): Max rebate amount
REBATE_THRESHOLD_NEW = Decimal("1200000")             # Sec 87A (new): Max total income for rebate
REBATE_MAX_NEW = Decimal("60000")                     # Sec 87A (new): Max rebate amount

# First Schedule - Surcharge Thresholds and Rates
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS = [
    (Decimal("5000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("10000000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("20000000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("50000000"), Decimal("0.37")),              # Note: Capped at 0.25 for new regime in logic
]

# Health and Education Cess Rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal("0.04")                           # Health and Education Cess rate


# ==========================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ==========================================

def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """
    Sec 288A / Sec 288B rounding:
    1. Floor to whole rupees (drop paise).
    2. Round to nearest multiple of 10 where last digit >= 5 rounds up.
    """
    floored = amount.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    remainder = floored % Decimal("10")
    if remainder >= Decimal("5"):
        return floored + (Decimal("10") - remainder)
    else:
        return floored - remainder


def compute_slab_tax(total_income: Decimal, slabs: list) -> tuple[Decimal, list[dict]]:
    total_tax = Decimal("0")
    trace = []
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if total_income <= lower:
            break
        upper_bound = total_income if upper is None else min(total_income, upper)
        taxable_in_slab = upper_bound - lower
        slab_tax = taxable_in_slab * rate
        total_tax += slab_tax
        if rate > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": f"Tax at {int(rate * 100)}% on income between {lower} and {upper_bound}",
                "amount": str(slab_tax),
                "clause": "First Schedule, Part III, Para A / Sec 115BAC"
            })
    return total_tax, trace


def compute_surcharge_and_marginal_relief(total_income: Decimal, base_tax: Decimal, is_new_regime: bool) -> tuple[Decimal, list[dict]]:
    applicable_thresholds = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS[:-1] if is_new_regime else SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS
    
    # Find the highest threshold exceeded
    active_threshold = None
    active_rate = Decimal("0")
    for thresh, rate in applicable_thresholds:
        if total_income > thresh:
            active_threshold = thresh
            active_rate = rate

    if active_threshold is None:
        return Decimal("0"), []

    # Calculate standard surcharge
    surcharge = base_tax * active_rate
    trace = [{
        "kind": "tax",
        "description": f"Surcharge at {int(active_rate * 100)}% on income exceeding {active_threshold}",
        "amount": str(surcharge),
        "clause": "First Schedule, Part III"
    }]

    # Determine lower rate for marginal relief calculation
    lower_rate = Decimal("0")
    for thresh, rate in applicable_thresholds:
        if thresh < active_threshold:
            lower_rate = rate

    # Calculate marginal relief
    # Tax + Surcharge on threshold income at threshold-entry rate (lower_rate) + (total_income - threshold)
    # Note: tax on threshold income using the same tax slabs
    slabs = SLABS_NEW if is_new_regime else SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60 # regime slabs logic handles income anyway
    # Actually, we need base tax at threshold. We can re-run slab tax for threshold:
    # To keep it simple, get base tax at threshold using appropriate slabs (slab function needs income)
    # We can pass slabs based on regime:
    # For old regime, age matters, but threshold is 50L+, where age brackets have same slab above 10L.
    # Let's import/use the correct slabs for threshold calculation:
    threshold_slabs = SLABS_NEW if is_new_regime else SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60 # standard for >50L
    tax_at_thresh, _ = compute_slab_tax(active_threshold, threshold_slabs)
    
    surcharge_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh * lower_rate
    max_allowed_tax_plus_surcharge = tax_at_thresh + surcharge_at_thresh + (total_income - active_threshold)
    actual_tax_plus_surcharge = base_tax + surcharge

    if actual_tax_plus_surcharge > max_allowed_tax_plus_surcharge:
        relief = actual_tax_plus_surcharge - max_allowed_tax_plus_surcharge
        surcharge -= relief
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Surcharge marginal relief",
            "amount": str(-relief),
            "clause": "First Schedule, Part III"
        })

    return surcharge, trace


def compute_regime_tax(total_income: Decimal, is_new_regime: bool, age: int) -> tuple[Decimal, Decimal, Decimal, list[dict]]:
    # Select slabs
    if is_new_regime:
        slabs = SLABS_NEW
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_ABOVE_80
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_60_80
        else:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60

    base_tax, trace = compute_slab_tax(total_income, slabs)

    # Sec 87A Rebate
    rebate = Decimal("0")
    if is_new_regime:
        if total_income <= REBATE_THRESHOLD_NEW:
            rebate = min(base_tax, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
        elif total_income > REBATE_THRESHOLD_NEW:
            # Marginal relief under Sec 87A for new regime
            # Tax should not exceed (total_income - 12,00,000)
            excess_income = total_income - REBATE_THRESHOLD_NEW
            if base_tax > excess_income:
                rebate = base_tax - excess_income
    else:
        if total_income <= REBATE_THRESHOLD_OLD:
            rebate = min(base_tax, REBATE_MAX_OLD)

    if rebate > 0:
        base_tax -= rebate
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Sec 87A rebate",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })

    # Surcharge & Marginal Relief
    surcharge, surcharge_trace = compute_surcharge_and_marginal_relief(total_income, base_tax, is_new_regime)
    trace.extend(surcharge_trace)

    tax_after_surcharge = base_tax + surcharge
    
    # Health and Education Cess
    cess = tax_after_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess at 4%",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Finance Act"
        })

    total_tax_unrounded = tax_after_surcharge + cess
    rounded_tax = round_nearest_ten(total_tax_unrounded)
    rounding_adj_tax = rounded_tax - total_tax_unrounded

    if rounding_adj_tax != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Sec 288B tax rounding adjustment",
            "amount": str(rounding_adj_tax),
            "clause": "Sec 288B"
        })

    return total_tax_unrounded, rounded_tax, surcharge, trace


def compute_old_regime(inp: dict) -> tuple[Decimal, int, list[dict]]:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp["gross_salary"]))
    age = inp["age"]
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp["hra_received"]))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp["basic_plus_da"]))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp["rent_paid"]))
    rent_city_is_metro = inp["rent_city_is_metro"]
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp["home_loan_interest"]))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80c"]))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80ccd_1b"]))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_self"]))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_parents"]))
    parents_senior = inp["parents_senior"]

    trace = []

    # Salary income start
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })

    current_salary = gross_salary

    # Standard Deduction Sec 16(ia)
    std_deduction = min(current_salary, STD_DEDUCTION_OLD)
    current_salary -= std_deduction
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Standard deduction",
        "amount": str(-std_deduction),
        "clause": "Sec 16(ia)"
    })

    # HRA Exemption Sec 10(13A)
    hra_exempt = Decimal("0")
    if hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        excess_rent = rent_paid - (basic_plus_da * Decimal("0.10"))
        if excess_rent > 0:
            city_rate = HRA_METRO_RATE if rent_city_is_metro else HRA_NON_METRO_RATE
            city_rent_limit = basic_plus_da * city_rate
            hra_exempt = min(hra_received, excess_rent, city_rent_limit)
            if hra_exempt < 0:
                hra_exempt = Decimal("0")
    
    if hra_exempt > 0:
        current_salary -= hra_exempt
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "HRA exemption",
            "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
            "clause": "Sec 10(13A)"
        })

    net_salary = max(Decimal("0"), current_salary)

    # House property loss
    hp_loss = min(home_loan_interest, HP_INTEREST_LIMIT)
    hp_loss_set_off = min(hp_loss, HP_SET_OFF_LIMIT, net_salary)

    gross_total_income = max(Decimal("0"), net_salary - hp_loss_set_off)
    if hp_loss_set_off > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Income from house property (loss set off)",
            "amount": str(-hp_loss_set_off),
            "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)"
        })

    # Chapter VI-A Deductions
    # Sec 80C capped at 1,50,000
    ded_80c = min(sec_80c, SEC_80C_LIMIT)
    # Sec 80CCD(1B) capped at 50,000
    ded_80ccd_1b = min(sec_80ccd_1b, SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT)

    # Sec 80D limits
    self_limit = SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR if age >= 60 else SEC_80D_SELF_NORMAL
    ded_80d_self = min(health_ins_self, self_limit)

    parents_limit = SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENTS_NORMAL
    ded_80d_parents = min(health_ins_parents, parents_limit)
    ded_80d = ded_80d_self + ded_80d_parents

    total_chapter_via = ded_80c + ded_80ccd_1b + ded_80d
    # Sec 80A(2) overall cap: Chapter VI-A cannot exceed gross total income
    total_chapter_via = min(total_chapter_via, gross_total_income)

    if total_chapter_via > 0:
        gross_total_income -= total_chapter_via
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Chapter VI-A deductions",
            "amount": str(-total_chapter_via),
            "clause": "Chapter VI-A"
        })

    unrounded_total_income = max(Decimal("0"), gross_total_income)
    rounded_total_income = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_total_income)
    rounding_adj_income = rounded_total_income - unrounded_total_income

    if rounding_adj_income != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Sec 288A total income rounding adjustment",
            "amount": str(rounding_adj_income),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })

    _, tax_payable, _, tax_trace = compute_regime_tax(rounded_total_income, is_new_regime=False, age=age)
    trace.extend(tax_trace)

    return rounded_total_income, int(tax_payable), trace


def compute_new_regime(inp: dict) -> tuple[Decimal, int, list[dict]]:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp["gross_salary"]))
    age = inp["age"]

    trace = []

    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })

    current_salary = gross_salary

    # Standard Deduction Sec 16(ia) read with Sec 115BAC
    std_deduction = min(current_salary, STD_DEDUCTION_NEW)
    current_salary -= std_deduction
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Standard deduction",
        "amount": str(-std_deduction),
        "clause": "Sec 16(ia) / Sec 115BAC"
    })

    unrounded_total_income = max(Decimal("0"), current_salary)
    rounded_total_income = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_total_income)
    rounding_adj_income = rounded_total_income - unrounded_total_income

    if rounding_adj_income != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Sec 288A total income rounding adjustment",
            "amount": str(rounding_adj_income),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })

    _, tax_payable, _, tax_trace = compute_regime_tax(rounded_total_income, is_new_regime=True, age=age)
    trace.extend(tax_trace)

    return rounded_total_income, int(tax_payable), trace


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    old_income, old_tax, old_trace = compute_old_regime(inp)
    new_income, new_tax, new_trace = compute_new_regime(inp)

    return {
        "old": {
            "total_income": int(old_income),
            "tax_payable": old_tax,
            "trace": old_trace
        },
        "new": {
            "total_income": int(new_income),
            "tax_payable": new_tax,
            "trace": new_trace
        }
    }
